newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM sets up 63rd cargo service centre.
newsitem.headline: KLM sets up 63rd cargo service centre.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines has set up its 63rd Cargo Service Centre (CSC), a spokesman told Reuters.
The new CSC has been set up at Skavsta Airport in Sweden and is fully operational. Cargo Service Centre Holding is a 100 percent subsidiary of KLM Cargo.
Each CSC is set up as an independent service provider and has its own profit responsibility, stressed the spokesman.
Currently, the CSC has two clients, Cargolux and KLM. However, the Skavsta centre is involved in 'promising talks' with other airlines, he said.
Aircraft handling, warehousing and trucking are offered at the CSC.
This latest CSC has a warehouse with a storage capacity of 2900 cubic metres and employs 18 people.

From February 17, KLM Cargo has been operating its five- times-weekly air freight service between Amsterdam and Sweden into Skavsta Airport which is 100 kilometres from Stockholm. Until then, the carrier was operating to Arlanda Airport which is near to Stockholm.
Shavsta is nearer to the industrial region where KLM Cargo's customers are, the airline said in a statement. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
